text_block_list.name: TV Show Host
text_block_list.text:
"To everyone watching at home!
Happy Neewww Yeeeaaarr!"

text_block_list.name: TV Show Host
text_block_list.text: Our broadcast brings you the latest on this year's Twinkle Series faster than anyone else!

text_block_list.name: TV Show Host
text_block_list.text:
First up, our annual New Year's corner!
'Who is this year's hot Umamusume?!'!

text_block_list.name: TV Show Host
text_block_list.text: “—First up, the prestigious Mejiro family! Keep your eyes on Mejiro McQueen and Mejiro Ryan!”

text_block_list.name: TV Show Host
text_block_list.text:
The late-blooming star actor, Mejiro McQueen!
Her talent as a stayer truly blossomed
in the Classic class Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: TV Show Host
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Mejiro Ryan! Despite a string of narrow misses, she fought valiantly along the Classic Triple Crown route! What kind of results will she show us this year?!

text_block_list.name: TV Show Host
text_block_list.text:
Next up! Keep your eyes on Daiichi Ruby
of the "Splendid Clan," who turned heads
last year with her sudden switch to sprint races!

text_block_list.name: TV Show Host
text_block_list.text:
Miss Ruby, who took the Triple Tiara route, versus
Miss McQueen and Miss Ryan, who were forged
on the Classic Triple Crown route...

text_block_list.name: TV Show Host
text_block_list.text:
Such a showdown was anticipated for the Senior Class,
so some fans may be disappointed... buuut!
Let us look forward to seeing her shine anew in sprints!

text_block_list.name: TV Show Host
text_block_list.text:
—And last but not least, this Umamusume!
Keep your eyes on Tokai Teio!

text_block_list.name: TV Show Host
text_block_list.text:
She enters the Classic tier this year!
Her extraordinary talent has already put her right in the spotlight!

text_block_list.name: TV Show Host
text_block_list.text:
She declared she'll surpass that "Emperor," Symboli Rudolf!
Just how many crowns will she claim on the classic path to glory?!

text_block_list.name: TV Show Host
text_block_list.text:
"Keep your eyes on the Twinkle Series for even more excitement this year!
And now, onto the next segment♪"

After the press conference at the Rose Stakes, the public remained bewildered by Daiichi Ruby's choice for a while.
Though it seemed the commotion would settle down once the new year came around—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—As long as we have their attention,
it shouldn't be a problem.
After finishing our first New Year's greetings, I casually brought up the topic... and as expected, she remained completely unperturbed.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, you need only accomplish
what must be done in the meantime."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
what are your thoughts on this?

She is blessed with natural speed.
By polishing those legs to an even brighter shine,
she will attain the "ultimate radiance" her family strives for.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Once I carry out this determination,
I am sure I will regain everyone's expectations.

I'll follow her lead and keep my back straight too.
Just as I was thinking that—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Haaaaappy New Yeeeeear!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Milady! Milady's Trainer!
Happy New Year to you both!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year.

She doesn't even bat an eye at the sudden partygoer.
Could Daiichi Ruby ever be shaken...
No, certainly not.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Tee-hee,
I just wanted to see you, Milady~...☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: This year's Takamatsunomiya Kinen! I'm running in it too~ decided on a whim!

The Takamatsunomiya Kinen is a GⅠ race; you can't enter
just for the fun of it. Which means she has the qualifications—
the true ability to run in it.

Having won a graded race last year, she'll undoubtedly
be a leading contender in the sprint division this year.
Our paths haven't crossed so far, but—
choice_data_list: Looks like Helios is going to be our rival for now.
Looks like Helios is going to be our rival for now.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Rivals...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe☆
I knew you'd think so too!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ojo and I are totally made for each other!
We've got a 15-centimeter height gap, and we're red and blue~♪
choice_data_list: Um, that's not quite what I meant, though.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I believe the only one we must truly confront
is none other than ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Haho?
Whatcha mean?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: The idea of focusing all my attention on just one person does not resonate with me.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Analyzing everyone equally and conquering oneself.
I know full well that is the certainty that leads to victory.
choice_data_list: (Come to think of it, she mentioned that before...)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Sssssooooo cooooool...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I believe your objective of meeting with me has been achieved.
Please take care on your way back.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Aaaand, soooul-tyy~...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Well then, I shall also—
(Vroom...)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
The schedule for the lesson after this has been changed
because the instructor isn't feeling well.

It hits me. In other words, Daiichi Ruby has free time
after this... Stoic as she is, she'll probably say she's going
to practice on her own, but since we have the chance...!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...That's true, volun—
choice_data_list: Could you give that time to me?
Could you give that time to me?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Meaning?
choice_data_list: How much time until the next plan?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: About an hour.

That chunk of time is more than enough.
She'll push herself to the limit again soon,
so I want her to refresh herself, even if just for a moment—
choice_data_list: Search for a new New Year's dish
Praying for growth at the nearby shrine.

text_block_list.text:
Good food really is the best way to refresh oneself.
For her, aiming to become a new symbol, a New Year's feast of the new era should be just right.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
With all due respect,
I cannot quite fathom what you mean by that.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh?
Good day, Ruby!

Stepping outside, I ran into Fine Motion.
A royal descendant currently living in Ireland,
she is visiting the Academy for a study-abroad trip.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Fine-san.
Happy New Year.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right!
Happy New Year♪
choice_data_list: (They look so elegant side by side...)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hey, do you two have some time?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You know, I'm thinking of pioneering a brand-new Japanese New Year's dish right now.
Care to join me?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you for the invitation.
My schedule happens to be completely open, so—"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you.

Considering Fine Motion's background,
I thought we'd be guided to some luxurious restaurant, but—

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
—Thanks for waiting!
Three "New Year's Special Ramens" coming right up!

Where I was brought was a ramen shop.
While question marks were floating over my head,
Fine Motion had already finished ordering—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Wah, it looks delicious!
Loaded with veggies and... is this kamaboko?
Red and white, how festive!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
"May our bond last long and slender like these noodles!"
That's the meaning woven into this special dish!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty sure the ingredients in osechi have meanings too, right?
That's so lovely, Ruby!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

Daiichi Ruby's expression seemed even stiffer than usual...
Just as I was about to ask if she wanted to grab some ramen instead—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
There are times when we entertain guests
who wish to enjoy everyday Japanese home-style food.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I am well-versed in table manners for occasions like this, so please don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the food.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the food!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Phew, huff...
That day became a rare occasion where one could witness Daiichi Ruby eating ramen with impeccable manners.

There should be a shrine just a short drive away.
Taking in the sacred air of a shrine might
help clear your mind, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Not a problem.
I shall accompany you."

I didn't really know why,
but she seemed willing to come along.
So we headed to the shrine by car.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
—Hunnyaka~... Hannyaka~...
Save us~, cleanse us~...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Matikanefukukitaru here!
The one I ran into by chance was the fortune-telling enthusiast Umamusume, Matikanefukukitaru.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Starting off the New Year, you really gotta pay respects to the gods so you can dump all your troubles onto them!
choice_data_list: Just dumping it all on me...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Are you two here to pay your respects too?
Go right ahead, the space in front of the offertory box is open!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I am here to accompany Trainer.
choice_data_list: Aren't you going to pray at the shrine?
Aren't you going to pay your respects?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I don't have any wishes to make, after all.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Haaeeh?!?
No wish at all?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"So there's someone like that...
And needing an escort means..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer.
You're supposed to toss the offering in!
Like clink-clank-clink!"
choice_data_list: It's okay, I know how to do it!

text_block_list.text: "And so, watched over by Daiichi Ruby, I prayed to the gods for her great breakthrough this year."
By reaffirming my wish in my heart, I can feel the energy welling up to make my goal a reality.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Funnyaka~... hannyaka~...
Feed me, please~ let me play, please~...
choice_data_list: Huh, weren't you just praying a second ago?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The gods possess speeectacular power!
It'll surely be fine to toss in a bit more!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oh my?! Ruby-san, you have a wish as well?!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
No.
As expected, it is unnecessary for me.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
However... I now understand that for some people,
it can have a profound effect.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Please do not forget
what you prayed for here.

For some reason, words I didn't even mean slipped out...!
Yet, this phrase felt strangely familiar—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I'm making a comebaaack~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Just when ya thought I went home, bam, I'm back!!
Like, y'all totally can't do without me, right?!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Isn't Trainer just straight-up a party animal?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And we're gonna hit up Paris, right!?
What should we do? What should we see~?!

It looked as though Daiichi Ruby might leave at any moment.
Maybe I should dispel this party animal curse right here...
If so, I might as well go all out!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayyy~, cheeeers!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hey hey, for an express-delivery rush job, isn't this turning into a legit party?!

Together, Daitaku Helios and I threw the absolute best
party we could muster. Even if it paled in comparison
to what Daiichi Ruby was used to—

For now, Daiichi Ruby seems to be observing the situation.
Out of politeness, she likely won't leave immediately either.
I must make sure she feels this break was worthwhile—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Looking for a light snack? Look no further!
We have Toughness Bars right here!
choice_data_list: It's packed with carrots and nutritious too!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I am aware. We received it from that company,
along with an explanation.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Fo' real!?
All-you-can-eat...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
They're showing footage of our race on that screen over there!
Photo by Palmer-chin☆
choice_data_list: Use this as a reference for sprint races.

text_block_list.text:
And so, with various things hastily prepared,
we entertained Daiichi Ruby.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...I have another appointment coming up,
so I shall take my leave now."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Fo' real!?
That went by in a flash...
choice_data_list: How was your time just now...?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I do not have any criteria
for evaluating parties like this.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Paoon!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "However, I could truly feel the dedication both you and Helios-san possess as my masters."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I believe the requirement of 'hospitality' has been satisfied.
Thank you for your hard work.
